tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor ma cha gsum lag len bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ gtor ma cha gsum du grags pa'i lag len la/ cho ga'i rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ rgyud sde'i dbye bas bya spyod kyi lugs dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs gnyis te/ gsum la gnyis kyis phye bas rgyud gzhung khungs ma rnams kyi bstan tshod la yang rtsa ba'i dbye ba drug tu 'byung zhing*/ bod snga ma rnams kyi lag len ni mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa'ang yod la/ de dag las skabs 'dir rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs cho ga bsdus pa ni 'di ltar bya ste/ 'bras yos bcas shing til dang bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu dag dang bcas/ /sran chan bcas shing la du dang*/ / snum 'khur la sogs bza' ba rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rgyu la/ gtor ma dang po dang gnyis pa lcog zlum dkar gtor re dang*/ gsum pa bgegs gtor dbus su shu lu g.yas g.yon du ting lo changs bur bcas pa'am/ mtheb kyu ting lo changs bu can byas kyang rung ste/ sha chang la phug sogs kyis kyang brgyan no/ / bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas gtor ma'i cho ga bya ste/ zhi drag la khyad par med do/ / mchod yon dang bcas pa'i nyer spyod lnga yang 'grub na tshar gsum bsham/ de tsam ma 'grub na tshar gcig bsham la kha gsos kyin mthar bgegs gtor gyi gtor snod du blugs pa yin/ shin tu bsdu na mchod pa de rnams yid kyis sprul pa ste/ 'on kyang dmigs pa la brtan pa thob pa yin na ma gtogs/ mchod yon la sogs pa dngos su bsham dgos so/ /mchod pa byin rlabs ni spro na logs su bya la/ bsdu na gtor ma'i byin rlabs dang lhan cig dmigs pas chog go /de la dang po phyogs skyong gi gtor ma ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/

zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa dang*/ swa bhā wa dang*/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin rlabs byas kyang rung ste phyi ma 'di bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor la cho ga rnal 'byor rgyud sogs rgyud sde gong ma dang mthun rung du bkral ba rnams dang sbyar na legs so/ / rang gi mdun du bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rdo rjes g.yab cing dril gsil dang bcas/ hūṃ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ / gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan btags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas yi dam bskyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig gadzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston zhing*/ / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs su 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi da sha di ga lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ye swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ zhes pa lan mang du brjod/ shin tu bsdu na/ oṃ da sha di ga lo ka pa la a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du puṣ+paṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ cung rgyas pa la dga' na/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ya swāhā/ oṃ ni ri t+ya ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ bā ya bai swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ i shā na ya swāhā/ oṃ prah+ma ṇe swāhā/ oṃ sur+ya ya swāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇ+yai swāhā/ oṃ na gā bh+yaḥswāhā/ oṃ a su ra bh+yaḥswāhā/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod yon phul de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis nyer spyod 'bul/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po= shar lho me lha'i= mchod cing = gshin rje be con 'chang pa'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po= lho phyogs= mchod cing = bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i= lho nub= mchod cing = zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi= nub phyogs= mchod cing = rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin= nub byang = mchod cing = gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor srungs= byang phyogs= mchod cing = dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po= byang shar= mchod cing = steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar lhar bcas la/ /mchod cing = 'og gi klu dang sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes pas bstod/ oṃ in+d+ra ye swāhā/ nas/ a su ra bh+yaḥswāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te sa s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ bā liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma btabs/ de nas tshigs bcad kyis 'bul ba ni/ dril thabs dang bcas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*/ / dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang*/ /ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la/ /so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dges pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par zhugs nas su/

/rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen mdun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog phreng ba dri dang byug pa dang*/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing gsol nas su/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces so/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces 'phrin las gzhol/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byang*/ /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ / lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid gyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad srung ba'i dge sbyong dag /sdug bsngal kun las nges par grol/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyogs pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /oṃ da sha di ga lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra gats+tsha/ mchod pa rnams gtor snod du blug la phyir btang ngo*/ /gnyis pa 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma ni/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ dril thabs dang bcas pas rdo rje g.yab cing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ / nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa ma gtsugs nas ni/ / thal lo sbyar nas khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan bdag slad du 'dir gshegs shig

/oṃ e h+ye hi lo ka ka rā ya/ sarba bhu ta ga ṇe sa pā ri wā ra/ sa mā ya swāhā/ e h+ye hi/ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ sarba bhu ta ga ṇe sa pā ri wā ra gṛh+ṇa da ma ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na dril gsil dang bcas pas sde brgyad so so'i bstod pas bstod/ bsdu na/ mthu ldan rang gi dam tshig la gnas pa/ /sa chu bar snang sa 'og mkha' la spyod/ /'jig rten rnams la 'phel zad las byed pa/ /sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs la bstod par bgyi/ /oṃ de wa nā ga yak+ṣa ga na dhar+bha a su ra ga ru ṭa kin+na ra ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya a nu ma ṣ+ya sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs btags pa lan bdun sogs kyis gtor ma stabs/ de nas tshigs bcad kyis 'bul ba ni/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu ldings ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gnas pa dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*/ /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang*/ /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ / lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng dang dri dang bdug pa dang*/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las de rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/

ces so/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la= sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung = sogs gong bzhin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu skye med chos/ /chos rnams thams cad bde bar gshegs dang 'dra/ /byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni/ /'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod/ ces pas chos bshad/ oṃ sarba bhu ta ga ṇi sa pā ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes mchod pa gnyis pa gtor ma gnyis par btab la phyir btang ngo*/ / gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ gong bzhin byin rlabs byas la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= sangs rgyas= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srungs ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yod pa thams cad phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la/ gtor ma len pa'i gnas su mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ gṛh+ṇe dam ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags gsum po de'i mthar/ na maḥsarba sogs btags pa lan bdun sogs kyi gtor ma bsngos/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ / de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi/ /gtor ma 'di yis mgu bar byos/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/

/sems can kun la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phan chad skyes par gyis/ / rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ni/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /chen po'am chung ngu gang yang rung*/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de rab tu phyung mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gi ci nus pas/ /mchod dang gtor ma phul ba yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gis 'dod pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /nad de rab tu phyung mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na 'di ltar/ bdag gis de ring khyod mchod kyi/ /song cig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis/ /phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong gi /khyod ni gegs kyang byed par nus/ khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste/ /khyod ni gegs byed mi nus min/ /sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pa/ /de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyis/ /me tog phreng ba spos dang dri/ /mar me gtor ma 'di khyer la// bgegs kyi dbang po 'gro bar gyis/ /sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis bral bar gyis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dag dang*/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis/ /gnod par gyur na mi legs kyi/ /gegs byed khyod ni da songs shig / ces brjod cing*/ mchod pa gtor mar btab la phyi rol du dor/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ grih+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'am bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung gang rung brjod cing mtshams bcad do/

/'di dag las rol mo'i sngags dang 'phrin las bcol la spro na rol chen yang bya la/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba zhes pa man chad la rnga tshigs byed pa'ang yod do/ / bgegs gtor gyi mtha'i tshams rngams kyi skabs 'dir/ lha zhi ba'i rnal 'byor kho na la gnas pas kyang nges par rung mod kyi/ rang nyid zhi bar gsal ba yin na thugs ka nas khro bo spro ba sogs kyi dmigs pa byed pa 'ga' zhig gi lag len du yang snang ba/ rnam pa gsal ba tsam yin la/ spyir 'di ni bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa tsam yin pa dang*/ mtshams gcod kyang rang nyid la srung ba'i don yin zhing*/ 'dre 'dul byed pa'i skabs ma yin pa go bar bya'o/ /mjug tu smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod do/ /de ltar na cha gsum gyi gtor chog mdor bsdus 'di yang*/ slob ma byams pa kun dga' la sogs pas bskul ba'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su smras pa'o// // bkra shis// dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gtor ma cha gsum lag len bzhugs/ -PAGE 330--PAGE 329--PAGE 322-
